sources.name: BodyParts3D
sources.license: CC-BY-SA-2.1-JP for the pinned mirror OBJ; DBCLS archive terms are separate
sources.attribution: BodyParts3D © Database Center for Life Science
sources.subject: Generic male atlas based on a single donor model with derived and edited surfaces
sources.coordinate_frame: Native OBJ mm, right-handed X left, Y posterior, Z superior (inferred convention)
sources.laterality: Per named FJ object; mirror and membership receipts retained
sources.local_pin: scripts/anatomy_lab/sources.lock.json and per-OBJ SHA-256 in the installed catalog
sources.compatibility: Bone and muscle geometry. Source membership is not an independently authored 4.3i graph. No subject match to the mechanics model or verified footprints.

sources.name: MS-Human-700
sources.subject: Generic compiled musculoskeletal model; no same-donor correspondence established
sources.coordinate_frame: MuJoCo right-handed metres, Z up; body-local sites and geom-local mesh vertices
sources.laterality: Native names and reviewed side in Crosswalk V3
sources.compatibility: Native 700 actuators, sites and wraps. Composite foot has no isolated calcaneus equivalent for this test.

sources.name: MyoSuite visual atlas
sources.license: CC-BY-4.0 for pinned visual asset; BodyParts3D attribution retained
sources.subject: BodyParts3D-derived display geometry; independent donor identity unavailable
sources.coordinate_frame: Source glTF metres, Y up, bind transforms in MotionScene; paired MuJoCo scene uses a fixed proper basis
sources.laterality: Display node and Crosswalk V3 identity status
sources.compatibility: Illustrative LBS display. Provenance precludes treating it as an independent atlas control.

sources.name: Foundational Model of Anatomy
sources.license: CC-BY-3.0 for the pinned supplement according to the repository provenance
sources.compatibility: Concept identity and terminology; no coordinate registration data.

sources.name: DBCLS muscle origin and insertion
sources.license: Exact workbook redistribution terms unverified; local only
sources.subject: Historical atlas modeling descriptions based on anatomy texts
sources.laterality: Text applies to named structures; no side-specific 3D annotations
sources.compatibility: 276 rows, 223 with both fields, zero numeric attachment cells and zero explicit FMA/FJ/BP ID tokens. Labels support candidate region descriptions only.

sources.name: OpenSim Upper Extremity Model
sources.license: Exact downloadable model license and bytes unverified
sources.subject: Generic upper-limb model with 50 muscle compartments
sources.coordinate_frame: Model frames; file version, axes and units unverified for this pilot
sources.compatibility: Potential model route and moment-arm comparison. No shared donor, reviewed coordinate mapping or experimental attachment polygons.

sources.name: Vergari 3D anatomic landmarks
sources.subject: 813 healthy subjects, free-standing biplanar reconstruction
sources.coordinate_frame: Reconstruction coordinates; no mapping to the installed model or pilot atlas
sources.format: CSV, companion landmark dictionary and figures
sources.compatibility: Spine, pelvis and lower-limb bone landmarks; no shoulder or muscle footprints. Different participants and no matched landmark coordinates on both pilot bones.

sources.name: Henninger Lab shoulder CT landmark evidence
sources.license: Record is open access; exact database reuse terms not established in this workbench
sources.subject: Mixed healthy/pathologic convenience sample of living and cadaveric shoulders; separately published seated biplane trials
sources.coordinate_frame: Native CT scanner frame; separate biplane coordinate frame for motion
sources.compatibility: Named scapular and humeral landmarks exist. Published definitions can guide annotation but no same-subject comparison to BodyParts3D/MS-Human. No verified pectoral footprints or clavicle/sternum match.
